title: privacy: tests/test_docs_regression.py:30-35 hardcodes absolute paths to the maintainer's private projects: /Users…
description:
[P2 · privacy · audit] tests/test_docs_regression.py:30-35 hardcodes absolute paths to the maintainer's private projects: /Users/luke/dev/products/{goala,fitkind,sitches,univiirse}/... — leaks both home path and private project names. (Test body is gated behind SIMEMU_CHECK_LOCAL_PRODUCT_DOCS=1 and skips missing paths, so it does not fail on members' clones — privacy leak only, not a functional break.) Also manifest owner/releaseOwner = "luke" and install.sh:3 usage comment uses /Users/luke/dev/onlytools/simemu.

Evidence: tests/test_docs_regression.py:30 `Path("/Users/luke/dev/products/goala/AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION.md")`; onlytools.manifest.json:10-11 `"owner": "luke", "releaseOwner": "luke"`; install.sh:3

Fix: Delete the local-product-docs test (or move those paths to an untracked local fixture); set manifest owner/releaseOwner to the org handle 'vykeai'; drop the absolute path from install.sh:3 comment.

Source: launch-readiness audit 2026-06-18
